context: #091 Piece B (residual). Prior spike (maze-encounter-disable.json) found a per-frame 0x4e08-plane re-stamp that suppresses the PLACED door-entry encounter (loop-top fire at wmaze 0x2b6a), letting the party walk several clean interior steps. But a RESIDUAL RANDOM encounter still fired after ~4-6 deeper steps; it does NOT read 0x4e08 and was believed to be a c47e (rng_next) roll. This pass found that residual source, its compare, and an AIRTIGHT capture-time poke. Static RE (Ghidra decompile + ndisasm of wmaze.ovr) + live verification on the dosbox-pure harness (new `encdisable2` phase in tools/libretro/trace-maze.ts).
summary: VERDICT: AIRTIGHT YES. The residual encounter is the c47e RANDOM-ENCOUNTER branch inside dungeon_main_loop (wmaze 0x2abc): at file 0x2d07 `mov ax,0x3e8` (1000); 0x2d0b `call 0xc47e` (rng_next, returns 0..999); 0x2d0f `cmp ax,0x3e3` (995); 0x2d12 `jl 0x2d3c` (7C 28) -> if ax<995 SKIP (no encounter), else (ax in 995..999, i.e. 5/1000 = 0.5% per loop iteration) falls through to 0x2d33 `mov word [0x363a],0x0a` (COMBAT INIT). This path reads ONLY the RNG state -- there is NO per-zone danger byte and NO step counter feeding THIS compare; both the rng range (0x3e8) and the threshold (0x3e3) are HARDCODED IMMEDIATES. So the airtight capture-time poke is a CODE PATCH: turn the conditional `jl 0x2d3c` (7C 28) at file 0x2d12 into an UNCONDITIONAL `jmp 0x2d3c` (EB 28), so the combat branch is never taken. Live result: with BOTH pokes (0x4e08-plane zero + the jl->jmp code patch) re-stamped per frame on a continuous session, the party walked 24/24 and 30/30 interior steps with gs staying 5 the WHOLE time (zero encounters, real movement across cells). CONTROL (plane poke ALONE, no code patch, same 30-step walk): the residual c47e encounter fired (gs flipped 5->10 at step 29). That contrast is the proof the code patch is the operative suppressor for the residual. The third in-loop combat writer (the all-asleep ambush at 0x2cf2, gated by FUN_0000_1e90 = whole party asleep) was NOT poked and NEVER fired -- a healthy capture party can't trip it.

findings.claim: The residual interior encounter is the c47e RANDOM-encounter branch in dungeon_main_loop. Per loop iteration (after the placed-encounter and special-handler checks), the engine rolls rng_next(1000) and fires combat if the roll is >= 995 -- a flat 0.5% per loop iteration, independent of cell, zone, party, or any memory gate. Because there are many loop iterations per emulated step, it accumulates to a fire every ~several-to-tens of steps (observed step 4-5 in the prior pass, step 29 in this pass's control -- consistent with a low-rate random roll, NOT a deterministic per-cell trigger). This is the encounter the 0x4e08-plane poke can't touch (this branch never reads 0x4e08).

evidence.details: ndisasm @ 0x2d07: B8E803 mov ax,0x3e8 (1000); 50 push ax; E87097 call 0xc47e (rng_next near-call, file 0x2d0b); 59 pop cx; 3DE303 cmp ax,0x3e3 (995, file 0x2d0f); 7C28 jl 0x2d3c (file 0x2d12); fall-through 0x2d14..0x2d32 writes the rng-variant byte + 0x4338/0x4354 = 0; 0x2d33 C7063A360A00 mov word [0x363a],0x0a (COMBAT INIT); 0x2d39 E934FE jmp 0x2b70 (loop exit/ret). Ghidra decompile of 0x2abc shows this as `local_c=1000; iVar5=func_0x0000c47e(); if (0x3e2 < iVar5) { ...; *(undefined2 *)0x363a = 10; return; }` (0x3e2 < ax  <=>  ax >= 0x3e3 = 995). LIVE: encdisable2 --noPatch control (plane poke only) walked 30 interior steps and the residual fired at step 29 (gs 5->10) -- proving an UNgated random fire that the plane poke alone does not stop.

findings.claim: The random-encounter RATE is a flat ~0.5% per loop iteration, hardcoded. rng_next(0x3e8=1000) returns 0..999; the compare `cmp ax,0x3e3` + `jl skip` fires combat for ax in {995,996,997,998,999} = 5/1000 = 0.5%. There is no per-zone danger byte, no 'steps-to-next-encounter' counter, no rate variable read on THIS path -- the two governing values (rng modulus 0x3e8 at file 0x2d08, threshold immediate 0x3e3 at file 0x2d10) are CODE IMMEDIATES. (NOTE: a separate DGROUP word *0x4f80/*0x4f82 IS incremented once per loop iteration at file ~0x2bb0 -- a global step/loop counter -- but it does NOT feed the c47e compare; it is not the encounter gate. Caveat: I did not exhaustively rule out *0x4f80 feeding some OTHER encounter path, only that the c47e residual branch does not read it.)

evidence.details: file 0x2d07 mov ax,0x3e8 (modulus immediate at file 0x2d08 = E8 03); file 0x2d0f cmp ax,0x3e3 (threshold immediate at file 0x2d10 = E3 03); file 0x2d12 jl 0x2d3c (7C 28). The decompile's other in-loop counters (puVar1=0x4f80; *0x4f80++ with carry into *0x4f82) sit BEFORE this block and are not arguments to c47e. The c47e arg is the literal 0x3e8 pushed at 0x2d0a.

findings.claim: The residual combat-init WRITER is `mov word [0x363a],0x0a` at wmaze FILE OFFSET 0x2d33 (the c47e branch's combat store), distinct from the placed-encounter writer at 0x2b6a (the loop-top 0x4e08 fire). On the live continuous session the wmaze overlay base (findOvl) was 0x4784, so the residual writer's runtime linear address is 0x4784 + 0x2d33 = 0x74b7 (exec-linear == findOvl base + file_offset). The combat write produces game_state=0x0a (combat init), observed live as gs flipping 5->10 in the --noPatch control. NOTE: a 0x363a write-watch was NOT separately re-run this pass to capture this cseip in the live drain stream (the prior pass hit the observability wall on the 0x0a write); the cseip is pinned by the static disasm + the behavioral contrast (patching exactly this branch's `jl` makes the gs=10 fire vanish), which is stronger than a single write-watch hit for the capture goal.

evidence.details: ndisasm: 0x2d33 C7063A360A00 mov word [0x363a],0x0a. Live findOvl base = 0x4784 (encdisable2 run). Runtime linear of the writer = 0x4784 + 0x2d33 = 0x74b7. Patching the GUARDING jump (file 0x2d12, linear 0x4784+0x2d12 = 0x7496) to unconditional skip eliminates the gs=10 fire (30/30 clean), confirming this branch is the residual source.

findings.claim: AIRTIGHT capture-time poke: write byte EB over the 7C at wmaze file 0x2d12 (linear = findOvl_base + 0x2d12), turning `jl 0x2d3c` into `jmp 0x2d3c` -- the c47e combat branch becomes unreachable. Re-applied per frame (alongside the 0x4e08-plane zero) on a CONTINUOUS dosbox-pure session, the party walked 24/24 and 30/30 interior steps with game_state staying 5 the entire time and REAL movement (cells changed: 124,121 -> 124,120 -> 124,119 -> 125,119 -> 125,120 -> 123,120, with turns). ZERO encounters. The CONTROL (--noPatch, plane poke alone) on the same 30-step walk fired the residual at step 29 (gs 5->10). So: plane poke suppresses the PLACED loop-top fire (0x2b6a); the jl->jmp code patch suppresses the RANDOM c47e fire (0x2d33); together they are airtight for the interior capture walk.

evidence.details: encdisable2 (both pokes per-frame): pre-patch bytes @ ovl+0x2d12 read `7c 28` (matches `jl 0x2d3c`); post-patch read `eb`. Bytes @ ovl+0x2d0e read `59 3d e3 03` (pop cx; cmp ax,0x3e3 -- confirms disasm alignment). Run 1 (stepN=24): gs=[5 x24] -> AIRTIGHT. Run 2 (stepN=30): gs=[5 x30] -> AIRTIGHT. CONTROL --noPatch (stepN=30): gs=[5 x29, 10] -> residual fired step 29. The patch is a single-byte code poke; it must be re-stamped per frame in case the overlay code page is reloaded (the harness re-stamps it before every step chunk, same cadence as the plane poke).

findings.claim: The third in-loop combat-init writer -- the all-asleep AMBUSH at wmaze 0x2cf2 (gated by FUN_0000_1e90()==1, which the decompile guards with `if (local_10 == *0x43ce)`, i.e. the count of party members with a status condition equals the party size -> whole party incapacitated/asleep) -- is NOT a concern for the capture campaign and was deliberately NOT poked. A healthy capture party never satisfies the all-asleep precondition, and it never fired across the airtight runs. If a future capture uses a status-afflicted party it could matter, but for the standard interior-capture party it is inert.

evidence.details: Ghidra decompile: `if (local_10 == *(int *)0x43ce) { ...; iVar5 = FUN_0000_1e90(); if (iVar5 == 1) { ...; *0x363a = 10; return; } }` where local_10 counts members with (*(char*)(m*0x1b0+0x450c) || *(char*)(m*0x1b0+0x450d)) != 0 over *0x43ce (party size). ndisasm: 0x2cf2 C7063A360A00 mov word [0x363a],0x0a. Across all airtight encdisable2 runs (24- and 30-step) the party stayed healthy (gs=5 throughout); this writer never fired.

verdict.evidence_summary: With BOTH pokes per-frame: 24/24 and 30/30 interior steps, ZERO encounters (gs stayed 5, real movement). CONTROL (plane poke alone, no code patch): residual fired step 29 (gs 5->10).
verdict.residual_writer: wmaze file 0x2d33 (`mov word [0x363a],0x0a`), the c47e random-encounter branch. Runtime linear on the observed session = findOvl_base(0x4784) + 0x2d33 = 0x74b7.
verdict.residual_gate: rng_next(0x3e8=1000) at file 0x2d0b, compared `cmp ax,0x3e3` (file 0x2d0f) + `jl 0x2d3c` (file 0x2d12). Fires for ax in 995..999 = 5/1000 = 0.5%/loop. Hardcoded immediates; NO memory rate/counter on this path.
verdict.working_poke: CODE PATCH: write byte 0xEB over file 0x2d12 (linear = findOvl_base + 0x2d12), making the guarding `jl 0x2d3c` unconditional so the c47e combat branch is never taken. Re-stamp per frame, alongside the 0x4e08-plane zero (and 0x4e68/*0x5032/*0x5034 zero for clean movement).
verdict.combined_recipe: Per frame on a continuous session: (1) zero the 0x60-byte 0x4e08 plane + the 0x60-byte 0x4e68 plane + *0x5032 + *0x5034 (suppresses the PLACED loop-top fire at 0x2b6a); (2) write 0xEB at ovl_base+0x2d12 (suppresses the RANDOM c47e fire at 0x2d33). The all-asleep ambush (0x2cf2) needs no poke for a healthy party.

unresolved: Whether *0x4f80/*0x4f82 (the per-loop counter incremented at ~file 0x2bb0) gates any OTHER encounter path was not exhaustively traced -- only confirmed it does NOT feed the c47e residual compare. For the capture goal this is moot (the two pokes are airtight), but if a deeper-zone encounter type appears, re-check the counter.

The residual writer cseip (0x2d33 -> linear 0x74b7) was pinned by static disasm + the behavioral patch-contrast, NOT by a fresh 0x363a write-watch hit (the prior pass hit the observability wall on the 0x0a write). The patch-contrast is decisive for the capture goal but if an independent cseip confirmation is ever wanted, a write-watch armed on 0x363a across a --noPatch walk should now catch the 0x0a write at this near-call site (it fires on a NORMAL interior step, unlike the zone-load path that escaped the prior watch).

A code patch is build-specific in the sense that it depends on findOvl resolving the wmaze overlay base each session (it did: 0x4784). If the overlay relocates differently across boots, the patch site moves with it -- findOvl handles this (patch site = findOvl_base + 0x2d12), so it is robust to relocation but assumes the wmaze.ovr code bytes at file 0x2d12 are 7C 28 (verified live: pre-patch read 7c 28).
harness: Added the `encdisable2 [forceAttempts] [stepN]` phase to tools/libretro/trace-maze.ts. Continuous driveToDoor -> force-only door open -> per-frame apply BOTH pokes (0x4e08/0x4e68/*0x5032/*0x5034 zero + the jl->jmp code patch at ovl+0x2d12) across the door-traverse and stepN interior steps (cycling direction so it doesn't just wall-bump) -> report gs after each step. `--noPatch` = CONTROL (plane poke only, to confirm the residual c47e fire). Run: `pnpm tsx tools/libretro/trace-maze.ts encdisable2 24 30` (airtight) / `... --noPatch` (control).
